raw_segments.text: Though in many different countries of Europe, taxes have been imposed upon the rent of houses,
I do not know of any in which ground rents have been considered as a separate subject
The contrivers of taxes have, probably, found some difficulty in ascertaining what part
of the rent ought to be considered as ground rent, and what part ought to be considered
It should not, however, seem very difficult to distinguish those two parts of the rent
